# uvrgw: Raspberry Pi Zero W with Waveshare RS485 CAN HAT, no graphics

# U-Boot selects the root slot and loads the kernel from it
kernel=u-boot.bin

# RS485 on UART0 (PL011, /dev/ttyAMA0, GPIO14/15), Bluetooth disabled
dtoverlay=disable-bt

# RS485 direction (RSE, GPIO4): low = receive
gpio=4=op,dl

# CAN: MCP2515 on SPI0 CE0, interrupt GPIO25; oscillator = crystal on
# the HAT (8 MHz on boards before 08/2019, 12 MHz on newer ones)
dtparam=spi=on
dtoverlay=mcp2515-can0,oscillator=8000000,interrupt=25

# USB OTG port in device mode: serial console on ttyGS0
dtoverlay=dwc2,dr_mode=peripheral
